title: Monster Messages
description: Match messages against grammar rules compiled into regular expressions, with recursive rule support.
writeup:
## Approach

Compile the grammar rules into a regular expression and match each message against it.

## Part 1

Recursively build a regex from rule 0: terminal rules become literal characters, alternatives become `(?:...|...)` groups, and sequences are concatenated. Match each message against the compiled pattern.

## Part 2

Rules 8 and 11 become self-referencing (recursive). Rule 8 becomes `42+` (one or more repetitions of rule 42). Rule 11 becomes `42{n} 31{n}` (balanced repetition). Since standard regex can't express true recursion, a depth limit on the recursive `build_regex` function naturally unrolls these rules to a sufficient depth. The depth limit of ~15 is more than enough for typical inputs.
